pages.title: Read the situation

pages.author: Scenario briefing · fictional
pages.subject: There used to be a cinema here
paragraphs: Fictional neighbourhood record: the corner cinema is now a pharmacy. The playground and its swings remain; new trees have been added. A former factory stands beside the square. The council has not yet confirmed its current use in this record.

pages.title: Walking through the old neighbourhood
pages.instruction: Listen for the problem, the response and the next step

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: I haven’t been here for years. Wasn’t there a cinema on this corner?
lines.audioText: I haven’t been here for years. Wasn’t there a cinema on this corner?
lines.translation: Faz anos que não venho aqui. Não tinha um cinema nesta esquina?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Yes, there used to be. It’s a pharmacy now
lines.audioText: Yes, there used to be. It’s a pharmacy now.
lines.translation: Sim, tinha. Agora é uma farmácia

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: That’s a shame. Did you use to go there?
lines.audioText: That’s a shame. Did you use to go there?
lines.translation: Que pena. Você costumava ir lá?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Most Saturdays. The tickets were cheap, and I could walk home afterwards
lines.audioText: Most Saturdays. The tickets were cheap, and I could walk home afterwards.
lines.translation: Na maioria dos sábados. Os ingressos eram baratos e eu podia voltar a pé

questions.prompt: Why did Ana use to go to the cinema?
questions.cue: Give a practical reason from the dialogue
questions.answer: The tickets were cheap and she could walk home

pages.title: What changed, and what stayed?
pages.instruction: Listen for the problem, the response and the next step

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: At least the playground is still here. It looks much greener
lines.audioText: At least the playground is still here. It looks much greener.
lines.translation: Pelo menos o parquinho continua aqui. Parece bem mais verde

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: It is. They’ve added trees, but they haven’t removed the old swings
lines.audioText: It is. They’ve added trees, but they haven’t removed the old swings.
lines.translation: Está mesmo. Colocaram árvores, mas não tiraram os balanços antigos

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Do you think the neighbourhood is better now?
lines.audioText: Do you think the neighbourhood is better now?
lines.translation: Você acha que o bairro está melhor agora?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: In some ways. There are more places to live, but I miss the small shops
lines.audioText: In some ways. There are more places to live, but I miss the small shops.
lines.translation: Em alguns aspectos. Há mais moradias, mas sinto falta das lojinhas

pages.title: Another change on the map
pages.instruction: Listen for the new information and decide how to respond
pages.message: Hi, Ana! I checked another change on our example map. There used to be a factory beside the square. It’s an apartment block now, with a small garden in front. The playground is still in the same place. A former resident told me he used to work at the factory, so he misses it, even though he likes the cleaner street. Would you show him what has changed and ask which part he remembers best?
pages.audioText: Hi, Ana! I checked another change on our example map. There used to be a factory beside the square. It’s an apartment block now, with a small garden in front. Would you show him what has changed and ask which part he remembers best?
